## **Цена и paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Цена и paywall.**
      4 свежих отзыв(ов) упоминают: цена и paywall.
      Период отзывов: 14 сент. 2026 г. - 20 сент. 2026 г.
      **Что это значит:** Пользователи упоминают цену, подписку или paywall. Это сигнал чувствительности к монетизации.

         **Примеры отзывов:**
            1. _Anthony Smith_, 16 сент. 2026 г., 1/5: "I haven't used the app in some time. As a matter of fact I uninstalled the app due to me finding another app. Unfortunately the app didn't give me the option to cancel my subscription and I'm still getting charged for something I don't have so, my ratings are changing and my subscription needs to be canceled immediately"
            2. _Erin Love_, 15 сент. 2026 г., 1/5: "I have canceled my subscription through Google Play. Store, as the app requires you to do. And I'm still being charged month after month. Getting to customer service, there's no easy way. How some of the reviews on here are so high, It's unbelievable. There's no easy way to cancel your account. The only way I can see is to cancel the account through google play service and then turn around and block each and every charge."
            3. _Callie Sanchez_, 20 сент. 2026 г., 2/5: "pretty pushy on the payment .. I explained to the supporters. To cancel my membership, they didn't want me too and also charged my card early I told the person, I had knee replacement surgery and I won't be able to do all those steps like it is in the calendar. I would just fall behind. I was trying to cancel and get my membership fee back. They didn't want to give me a full refund I was negotiating my own money back, from 25% refund to 50% refund. my bank took care of it."
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Баги и стабильность** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Баги и стабильность.**
      2 свежих отзыв(ов) упоминают: баги и стабильность.
      Период отзывов: 13 июн. 2026 г. - 14 сент. 2026 г.
      **Что это значит:** Пользователи упоминают краши или нестабильность. Это actionable только при всплеске или после обновления; иначе часто baseline-шум.

         **Примеры отзывов:**
            1. _Mel_, 13 июн. 2026 г., 1/5: "Bug d'application complète. Tentative de prélever un deuxième montant sans mon autorisation de plus de 60 euro. méfier vous. mais le pire c est que 2 mois plutard. il tente encore de vous voler des montant entre 50 et 60 euro. Pas d échéance j ai bloqué la carte. à fuire"
            2. _Wanda Fay_, 14 сент. 2026 г., 4/5: "How do I get the Print out sheet for Tai Chi Chair Yoga? Can't find it in the Lasta App? Did My first workout and I have to say it was a lot more difficult than I thought it would be. I have Balance issues so it makes it more difficult for me."
            3. _Liz_, 13 сент. 2026 г., 4/5: "the experience has been very interesting. had a little issue but with some great help from the support section especially from Lily Cole everything was sorted out very quickly. many thanks Lily"
<!--/ir-theme-->
